Senses.Explanation: A lineage master: the designation for someone presented or judged in relation to the Chan ancestral line. The term is repeatedly attested. Daowu Wuzhen gives a direct role statement: “As for a lineage master, he takes away the poor child's pearl sewn in his clothes and examines the accomplished person's viewpoint” (夫宗師者，奪貧子之衣珠，究達人之見處). Dahui Zonggao says that a lineage master decides right and wrong and must open people's eyes rather than rely only on blind cangues and sightless blows (大凡宗師決斷是非。要得開人眼目。不可一向盲枷瞎棒). Zhaozhou Congshen says a lineage master must meet people with the fundamental matter. Yuanwu Keqin likewise says the lineage-master household must teach a person through, even at the cost of injuring hand and blade when the person does not understand (宗師家為人須為教徹). Yuanwu calls Zhaozhou Congshen “a great-handed lineage master” (大手宗師), saying that Zhaozhou does not discuss mystery, marvel, occasion, or object but meets people with the fundamental matter. He also calls Dongshan Shouchu, Zhimen Guangzuo, Deshan Yuanming, and Xianglin Chengyuan “great lineage masters” (皆為大宗師). The label can be withheld or mocked: Xuedou Chongxian says of an inadequate answer, “calling oneself a lineage master like this and wanting to open the eyes of humans and gods—only in the donkey year” (如此自稱宗師，欲開人天眼目，驢年去). The noun thus works as a title and appraisal tied to public responsibilities, and as a rebuke when a claimant does not meet them.

Senses.Explanation: The school’s essential point is what its responsible holder must bear, uphold, and bring forward. Yuanwu calls double gathering and double release fit to serve as the school’s essential point, and elsewhere speaks of carrying it in the mountains for others. Shanhui says it is not transmitted in words; Zide calls it a single section with no other track; Fushi says raising it requires a capable person; Erzhan contrasts continually raising it with making entry possible; and Rujing’s verse distributes it among the five houses. One later lamp phrase is retained only as a supplemental recension.

Senses.Explanation: The Zen lineage tradition is the inherited school domain whose characteristic business, standards, and strengths speakers raise and test. The literal wording is “lineage gate.” Yuanwu Keqin begins from 既謂之宗門 (“since it is called the lineage gate”) and warns against abandoning the root for verbal situations. Wuyi Yuanlai contrasts a teaching-house limit with 宗門下長處 (“the distinctive strength within the lineage gate”). Public questions ask for 宗門中事 (“affairs within the lineage tradition”), while Feiyin Tongrong calls a capable participant 宗門中客 (“a guest within the lineage tradition”). Li Changgeng’s possessive 吾宗門 (“our lineage tradition”) narrows the same relation to his own inherited house rather than redefining every occurrence as one named branch.

Senses.Explanation: The lineage's house style: the recognizable way a Chan house carries and displays its inheritance. Public interviews repeatedly pair it with the song the named respondent sings and ask from whom it descends. Linji Yixuan answers by recalling his three beatings under Huangbo Xiyun; Xingyang Guijing points to Shaoshi, Shoushan Shengnian to a personal transmission there, Baizhang Zhiying to an image held in the palm, and Qingshan Hao to a charge received at Vulture Peak and enacted at Wenshui. Konggu Daocheng speaks of fanning this style until plants come alive, Juelang Dasheng asks supporters to sustain it together, and Guxue Zhe says it will greatly flourish. Chan bends ordinary school custom into an inheritance whose validity is made public in answers and conduct.

Occurrences.Kwic: 梳蓬亂髮，喜遇當來賓。問：樓閣門中還容打瞌睡漢也無？師云：待汝醒後即向你道。問：善財五十三參，未審如今還行脚也未？師云：洗脚上牀眠，一夜三千里。問：楞伽山既不可往，為甚麼被夜叉王所據？師云：手親眼便，脚頭脚底。問：鱉鼻蛇撞著赤眼人，作何躲閃？師云：恰好，恰好。問：五家宗旨俱明，因甚麼輪迴不息？師云：󳺴火燒山，有光無𦦨。問：維摩經云：除去諸有，併諸侍者。為甚麼連侍者不存？師云：久住令人賤，新來語自親。問：世尊赤手空拳，開已又屈，屈已又開，未審明那邊事？師云：祇明者箇事。問：一切事究竟堅固，不知大佛頂還在裏許否？師云：暗裏抽橫骨，明中坐舌頭。問：棒喝如雷，還供養得閻鬍子也無？師云：閻鬍子若來，也須喫棒。問：從前老和尚髑髏，即今還有眼也無？師云：布袋裏老鴉，雖活如死。問：釋迦、彌勒還詶引滿二業也未？師云：二業是他果用，說甚麼詶與不詶？問：金剛經云：應生無所住心。既無所住，又作麼生心？師云：巖花鋪地高秋興，松月啣山報曉晴。問：佛之一字，吾不喜聞。某甲不求佛日用事作麼生？師云：下咽勒把筯，燒火擇乾柴。問：古德云：渠無生死。世人因何又被生死使？師云：青山元不動，白日鬼迷人。米旦生孝廉問：是何面目？師云：天不葢，地不載。進云：作何究竟？師云：地不載

Occurrences.Kwic: 須是知音；同死同生，方堪受敵。廓侍者獨立於懸崖石上，翻身倒捋虎鬚；周金剛安坐於大海波心，背手逆擒麟角。在檀特山前列陣，向占波國裏爭鋒。分明有輸有贏，且道誰得誰失？請諸人斷看。報恩秀云：若問萬松：從上諸聖向什麼處去？便與攔腮一掌，云：在者裏。直教飛龍跛鼈縮項攢蹄，侍者德山亡鋒結舌。雖然，還識德山老漢麼？少年曾決龍蛇陣，老倒還聽稚子歌。南堂欲云：德山固是作家，爐鞲本分鉗錘，怎奈廓侍者是煅過了的金，從他以己方人，畢竟無屈可受。靈巖與麼批判，莫有為雪竇作主者麼？博山來，云：德山一條棒，尋常血滴滴地，到者裏因甚不用？還會麼？暗裏抽橫骨，明中坐舌頭。古南門云：猛虎口裏橫身，毒蛇頭上揩癢。一出一入，一挨一拶，不妨好手。雪竇恁麼舉，從上諸聖且置，者一隊漢向什麼處去？可憐無限弄潮人，畢竟還落潮中死。資福廣云：探頭太過者，墮坑落壍而不知；輸機誘敵者，奔南敗北而不辭。妙略神算，終古無雙，待得眼開，劒去久矣。白巖符云：廓公一期俊俏，不玷旁觀；德山養子之緣，殊費乳血。若是諸聖去處，咄！劒去久矣，爾方刻舟。蓮柎筞云：廓老輪鞭深入，其奈搏擊無功。德山兩度班師，祗解暗中屈敵。放過則二俱作家，檢點則總欠一著。然雖如是，不是沙場行陣久，揭天犪鼓喪紅塵。守廓因行脚到襄州華
